# nexus_os/bridge/governed_egress_relay.py  (or append to browser_http_diagnostic.py)
from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Dict, Any, Optional, Set
import hashlib
import time
import ipaddress
# Reuse/adapt your accepted Egress* classes here (copy from scratch if needed)
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EgressRequest:
target: str
payload: Dict[str, Any]
intent: str = "read"
@dataclass
class EgressDecision:
action: str  # "proxy_via_bridge" | "block" | "require_kaiju_approval"
reason: str
proxy_plan: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None
risk_level: str = "low"
@dataclass
class EgressResult:
status: str
decision: EgressDecision
audit_id: Optional[str] = None
token_budget_remaining: Optional[int] = None
class GovernedEgressRelay:
"""
Stage 2: Wraps BrowserHTTPDiagnosticRelay semantics.
Dry-run default. Live mode delegates to GROSS bridge on 7354.
Sandbox calls this via MCP/tool or nexusctl gross-http.
"""
HTTPS_ONLY = True
ALLOWED_METHODS = {"GET", "HEAD"}
ALLOWLIST: Set[str] = {"huggingface.co", "grok-audit.local"}
BLOCK_PRIVATE = True
STRIP_HEADERS = {"cookie", "authorization", "x-api-key", "proxy-authorization"}
def __init__(self, dry_run: bool = True, live_bridge_url: str = "http://localhost:7354"):
self.dry_run = dry_run
self.live_bridge_url = live_bridge_url  # GROSS bridge
self.token_budget = 100
# In real: self.base_relay = BrowserHTTPDiagnosticRelay(...)
def _sanitize_target(self, target: str) -> str:
if self.HTTPS_ONLY and not target.startswith("https://"):
raise ValueError("HTTPS only")
if self.BLOCK_PRIVATE:
try:
host = target.split("://")[1].split("/")[0]
ip = ipaddress.ip_address(host)
if ip.is_private or ip.is_loopback:
raise ValueError("Private/local target blocked")
except Exception:
pass  # domain names are fine
if not any(d in target.lower() for d in self.ALLOWLIST):
raise ValueError("Target not in explicit allowlist")
return target
def _sanitize_headers(self, headers: Dict[str, str]) -> Dict[str, str]:
return {k: v for k, v in headers.items() if k.lower() not in self.STRIP_HEADERS}
def plan_egress(self, req: EgressRequest) -> EgressDecision:
try:
self._sanitize_target(req.target)
if req.intent not in ("read",):
risk = "high"
else:
risk = "low"
except ValueError as e:
return EgressDecision(action="block", reason=str(e), risk_level="medium")
# TokenGuard stub (replace with real call in integration)
if self.token_budget < 1:
return EgressDecision(action="block", reason="TokenGuard budget exhausted", risk_level=risk)
self.token_budget -= 1
if risk == "high":
return EgressDecision(action="require_kaiju_approval", reason="High-risk intent requires KAIJU", risk_level=risk)
proxy_plan = {
"backend": "GROSS_bridge_7354",
"endpoint": self.live_bridge_url,
"target": req.target,
"method": "GET" if req.intent == "read" else "POST",
"note": "dry-run plan — live mode will call GROSS bridge"
}
return EgressDecision(action="proxy_via_bridge", reason="Allowlisted, governed plan ready", proxy_plan=proxy_plan, risk_level=risk)
def execute_egress(self, req: EgressRequest, live: bool = False) -> EgressResult:
decision = self.plan_egress(req)
audit_id = hashlib.sha256(f"{req.target}:{time.time_ns()}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
if decision.action != "proxy_via_bridge":
return EgressResult(status=decision.action, decision=decision, audit_id=audit_id)
if not live or self.dry_run:
return EgressResult(status="planned", decision=decision, audit_id=audit_id, token_budget_remaining=self.token_budget)
# LIVE path — delegate to GROSS bridge on 7354 (operator-controlled, has internet)
# In real impl: use internal client or subprocess to nexusctl gross-http or direct to 7354
# Example (replace with actual GROSS client):
try:
# sanitized_headers = self._sanitize_headers(req.payload.get("headers", {}))
# result = requests.get(..., timeout=10) or call to bridge
result = {"status": 200, "content": "simulated via GROSS 7354", "note": "live execution via existing bridge"}
return EgressResult(status="executed", decision=decision, audit_id=audit_id, token_budget_remaining=self.token_budget)
except Exception as e:
return EgressResult(status="error", decision=decision, audit_id=audit_id)
# Convenience for CLI / tool
def create_governed_relay(dry_run: bool = True) -> GovernedEgressRelay:
return GovernedEgressRelay(dry_run=dry_run)

import pytest
from nexus_os.bridge.governed_egress_relay import (
GovernedEgressRelay, EgressRequest, create_governed_relay
)
class FakeGROSSBridge:
def call(self, plan):
if "evil" in plan.get("target", ""):
raise ConnectionError("blocked by policy")
return {"status": 200, "body": "fake success from GROSS 7354"}
@pytest.fixture
def relay():
r = create_governed_relay(dry_run=True)
r.live_bridge_url = "http://localhost:7354"  # fake
return r
def test_allowlisted_read_dry_run(relay):
req = EgressRequest(target="https://huggingface.co/api/models", payload={}, intent="read")
dec = relay.plan_egress(req)
assert dec.action == "proxy_via_bridge"
assert dec.proxy_plan["backend"] == "GROSS_bridge_7354"
def test_non_allowlisted_blocks(relay):
req = EgressRequest(target="https://evil.example.com", payload={}, intent="read")
dec = relay.plan_egress(req)
assert dec.action == "block"
def test_high_risk_requires_kaiju(relay):
req = EgressRequest(target="https://huggingface.co", payload={}, intent="write")
dec = relay.plan_egress(req)
assert dec.action == "require_kaiju_approval"
def test_token_exhaustion(relay):
relay.token_budget = 0
req = EgressRequest(target="https://huggingface.co/api/models", payload={}, intent="read")
dec = relay.plan_egress(req)
assert dec.action == "block"
assert "TokenGuard" in dec.reason
def test_live_execution_uses_fake_bridge(relay):
relay.dry_run = False
req = EgressRequest(target="https://huggingface.co/api/models", payload={}, intent="read")
result = relay.execute_egress(req, live=True)
assert result.status in ("planned", "executed", "error")  # depends on fake
